connector.notes: Lets the app send entries into TallyPrime. By default each one arrives as an optional voucher, so nothing touches your books until you approve it inside Tally; the new Entries tab in the connector window lets you change that. Also adds a Sync speed setting for shops whose Tally slows down during a sync. Not mandatory: an older connector keeps working for reports, it just cannot receive entries.

android.notes: Record a receipt, payment or sale from your phone with the new + button. It goes into TallyPrime for approval, and waits safely on our server if your PC is off.
